feeds.title: Maritime Mastiffs Blog
feeds.description: Here at Maritime Mastiffs, we have been producing strong, healthy, and loving companions since 2019. We continue striving to keep the English and Italian Mastiff breeds as traditional as possible. We began our journey breeding American Bandogges. Our goal is to unite families with lifelong companions that match their lifestyle and ensure that our puppies join forever-loving families with which they will thrive.

feeds.title: Hickory Creek Mastiffs Blog
feeds.description: We are Todd & Monica Baughman. We are the breeder behind Hickory Creek Mastiffs located in Hebron, OH. Our puppies are raised with lots of love and special care. We personally place our puppies case by case. We breed fully health-tested, AKC-championed Mastiffs that represent the breed standard in appearance, structure, and temperament. We love these dogs and so will you!

feeds.title: Showsight Magazine » Mastiff
feeds.description: Showsight Magazine-the world's most influential purebred dog publication since 1992. It is dedicated to preserving the history and health of purpose-bred dogs. Filled with award-winning editorials focused on news and insights from the dog show community, top breeders, handlers, AKC Judges, and more! The Mastiff blog is an easy place to find helpful articles on topics new or soon-to-be new owners of this breed might need.

feeds.title: Hepper » Mastiff Blog
feeds.description: Hepper® is a products and resources company for pets that was born from that universal thought: 'There's got to be a better way'. We realized that a house full of cats invariably means rooms full of ugly cat toys and furniture. Explore the Masriff blog to learn everything and anything about Mastiff dogs and also get to know how to train them.

feeds.title: Your Mastiff
feeds.description: This website is dedicated to beautiful Mastiff breeds including Cane Corso, English Mastiff, Bullmastiff, Pyrenean Mastiff, etc, and their mixes. If you love these large and loyal breeds, who are always ready to stand up for their family but love just as much to lounge on your couch snuggled up to you -this website is for you. I hope you find all the information you need about these beautiful giants here.

feeds.title: MastiffWeb.com Blog
feeds.description: Home to all Mastiff breed lovers! Mastiffs are large classic family-oriented dogs that have a gentle, loving, and protective nature. Our blog focuses on providing information about different breeds of Mastiff dogs such as the English Mastiff, Tibetan Mastiff, French Mastiff, Cane Corso, Bull Mastiff, Pyrenean Mastiff, and more.
